Name: Platonic Soulmates
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[size=4][b]Platonic Soulmates:[/b][/size]
Have you ever gotten collector's anxiety and felt like you were missing out on items, events, and map elements that usually require marriage? Whether you're avoiding romance, roleplaying a different kind of character, or simply trying to see everything the game has to offer, this mod lets you experience relationship content while staying just friends.

Platonic Soulmates allows you to form a lifelong friendship with any datable NPC, unlocking their final friendship hearts and friendship-focused content without entering a romantic relationship.

Upon reaching 8 hearts with a datable NPC, the Old Mariner (or Older Mariner, depending on your config) will begin selling a new item: the Merman Pendant. Gifting it to a datable NPC will make you soulmates, unlocking the final friendship hearts through a fully custom heart system. If you change your mind, simply lower friendship or gift them a Bouquet to return to the normal relationship path.

To make these friendships feel meaningful, Platonic Soulmates includes reworked heart events that replace or supplement relationship content where appropriate. Events are chosen on a case-by-case basis, with heavily romantic scenes excluded in favor of content that still makes sense between close friends.

[size=4][b]Main Features:[/b][/size]
• Reworked platonic heart events for every vanilla and Stardew Valley Expanded datable NPC.
• Unlock the final friendship hearts without dating or marriage.
• Fully custom friendship progression system.
• Reworked platonic heart events for all vanilla and SVE datable NPCs.
• Collect spouse portraits without needing multiple marriages.
• Gain access to various friendship-gated items, events, and content.
• Translation support through the included i18n files.

[b][size=4]Additional Notes:[/size][/b]
This mod was designed primarily for single-player and multiplayer compatibility is not guaranteed.
If you encounter issues, please report them and include any relevant SMAPI logs. Debug commands are included to help repair older save data when necessary.

[b][size=4]Thank You:[/size][/b]
What started as a simple "I want Alex's sports room without dating Alex" project ended up becoming much bigger than I originally intended.

My original goal was just to make some of the friendship-gated rewards accessible without requiring multiple marriages. As I worked on it, I realized that many of the game's later character moments were also locked behind romance. Rather than simply unlocking the rewards, I wanted to preserve the character development that came with them. That eventually led to reworking heart events across vanilla Stardew Valley and later Stardew Valley Expanded so those stories could be experienced through close friendship instead.

At the end of the day, I made this mod because I wanted to marry Penny and stay faithful to her while still collecting the cool items and experiencing the content hidden behind other relationships.

Thank you to everyone who downloaded the mod, reported bugs, provided feedback, and helped shape it over the course of development.
Don't worry, I'm not abandoning the mod, but I am stepping back from active development for now. If Stardew Valley 1.7 ever comes around and ConcernedApe adds some really cool new marriage content, perhaps Clint and Sandy will find their way onto the soulmate roster as well.
